title: quercus calophylla f. intermedia
intro: Quercus calophylla f. intermedia, commonly known as a variant of the scrub oak, is a shrub or small tree species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. The therapeutic actions of Quercus calophylla f. intermedia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are also responsible for its potential to protect against cell damage, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
